mapper.select: SELECT m.num, m.NICKNAME, p.BIRTH, i.PROFILEIMAGE, d.date_location FROM date_REQUEST d JOIN MEMBER m ON d.REQUESTER_ID = m.nickname JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE p ON p.MEMBERID = m.num JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGES i ON i.USERID = m.num WHERE d.RECEIVER_ID=#{nickname} AND d.STATUS='accepted' UNION SELECT m.num, m.NICKNAME, p.BIRTH, i.PROFILEIMAGE, d.date_location FROM date_REQUEST d JOIN MEMBER m ON d.RECEIVER_ID = m.nickname JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE p ON p.MEMBERID = m.num JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE_IMAGES i ON i.USERID = m.num WHERE d.REQUESTER_ID=#{nickname} AND d.STATUS='accepted'
